name: 95409 · Santa Rosa, CA
findings: ZIP 95409 (Santa Rosa) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95409 (Santa Rosa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 6 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
